description: a dignified middle-aged slavic woman healer for hire, greying chestnut hair under a white linen kerchief, warm brown eyes, a long cream linen robe with a red embroidered border, a dark green shawl, a carved wooden sun amulet on a cord, a wooden staff topped with a sun in her hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
